prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE transparent mobile-board-game icon spritesheet with EXACTLY TWO independent icons, side by side, left and right. Wide canvas target 1536 x 768. True alpha outside the icons. Each icon must be fully visible with generous clean transparent margin and a large empty transparent gutter between them. No connecting decoration.
Primary request: Newly illustrate two small HUD resource symbols matching warm, chunky, friendly toy-isometric 2D game landmark art. They are bare icons ONLY, not a HUD bar, button, card or screenshot crop. Strong readable silhouettes at around 28 pixels high, restrained simple internal shading and beveled edges. Slight elevated three-quarter toy view, consistent light from upper left. Avoid excessive realism and glossy effects.
LEFT ICON — LEVEL STAR: a compact bright cyan/royal-blue MULTI-POINT STARBURST emblem, about eight broad points, with a warm GOLD beveled rim. A small simple warm-gold star-shaped face at its center evokes the level symbol. Keep the blue starburst body clearly visible and the gold rim clean and thin. One unified small star emblem, no disk, shield, ribbon, pedestal or surrounding frame. No number inside.
RIGHT ICON — GREEN HOUSE/BUILDING STACK: one compact green group of squat little house/building blocks, a broad front green house form and a second slightly offset building peeking behind/above it. A simple sloped roof and thick dark-green edge distinguish the silhouette, monochrome emerald/grass-green palette with lighter green roof faces and darker green side faces. Keep it wide and low, like a stacked property resource symbol, not a tall realistic townhouse. Minimal/no window detail so it reads clearly at HUD size.
Both must be freshly drawn, independent isolated silhouettes. Their overall visual sizes should be comparable, with the house stack naturally a little wider and lower than the star.
Strict exclusions: no letters, numbers, currency, captions, resource count, logo, watermark, circle/backplate, white/cream panel, HUD bar, frame, card, button, badge count, star ratings, drop/cast/contact shadow outside the object, glow, sparkle, scenery, ground plane, gray/checkerboard painted background. Internal form shading is allowed, external shadows will be engine-native. Preserve actual transparency.

reference.use: Directly viewed, shape/color reference only; no screenshot artwork pasted

objects: blue multi-point level star with gold rim/inner star

cropAuthorization: User explicitly approved exact alpha-boundary cropping of newly generated assets; full PNG master preserved.
scope: Only new image files, import mirrors and own asset manifest. No source, browser, sample design, UI, guide, STATUS or automation changes.
processingNotes: Each icon uses the tight rectangular alpha16 crop of its separate tile; no resampling or ratio change.
Low-alpha pixels outside the chosen crop are excluded by the crop; no alpha/color repaint inside the crop.
WebP q95 derivatives preserve cropped alpha exactly and stay under 300000 bytes.
differencesAndUnverified: Newly drawn source-inspired symbols, not pixel-identical copies.
Generated gold rim is chunkier than the small reference; house stack is simplified for small-size readability.
No external shadow was composited; internal highlights and form shading belong to each icon.
Actual HUD fit, text separation, registered asset references and final user review are parent tasks.
